questions.question: What can a trailer brake hand valve be used for on a truck?

options.text: Add fuel to the truck.
Stop the truck from rolling backward when starting from a stop.
Check the engine oil level.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop the truck from rolling backward when starting from a stop.
questions.explanation: A trailer brake hand valve can stop the truck from rolling backward when you start from a stop.

questions.question: What is aggressive driving?

options.text: Driving in a selfish or pushy way.
Driving with care for other drivers' safety.
Driving in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving in a selfish or pushy way.
questions.explanation: Aggressive driving means driving in a selfish, bold, or pushy way without concern for other drivers' rights or safety.

questions.question: What should you look for when checking power steering hoses during a pre-trip inspection?

options.text: Leaks.
Secure connections to the battery.
Extra hose pieces for repairs.

questions.explanation: During a pre-trip inspection, check power steering hoses for leaks. Also check the pump and fluid level.

questions.question: How much should you reduce your speed when driving on packed snow?

options.text: One-half or more.
About one-third.
About one-quarter.

questions.explanation: Reduce your speed by one-half or more when driving on packed snow, which has less traction.

questions.question: What should you do if the coolant temperature gauge goes above the highest safe temperature?

options.text: Continue driving.
Pull over and find out what is wrong.
Run the air conditioner.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over and find out what is wrong.
questions.explanation: Stop driving as soon as possible if the coolant temperature gauge goes too high. There may be a serious problem that could cause engine failure or fire.

questions.question: Which of these is acceptable during a pre-trip inspection?

options.text: Mismatched tire sizes
Front tire tread of 3/32 of an inch
Tires made by different manufacturers

questions.explanation: Front tires must have at least 4/32 inch of tread. Other tires must have at least 2/32 inch of tread. All tires on the same vehicle must be the same size.

questions.question: Is using a hand-held mobile device while driving allowed?

options.text: No, it is not allowed.
Yes, if the weather is clear.
Yes, if it is work-related.

questions.explanation: Using a hand-held mobile phone while driving is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What should a driver do on a slippery road?

options.text: Make turns as fast as possible.
Do not pass other vehicles.
Stop quickly.

questions.explanation: On slippery roads, drive slowly and smoothly. Make gentle turns and do not pass other vehicles unless necessary.

questions.question: What is the best way to stop if your brakes fail while driving downhill?

options.text: Steer onto an escape ramp.
Let the vehicle slow down on its own.
Let rumble strips slow your vehicle.

questions.explanation: An escape ramp is the best option if your brakes fail going downhill. If no escape ramp is available, steer into an open field or side road that is flat or goes uphill.

questions.question: What is black ice usually like?

options.text: Usually thick.
Usually thin.
Not a hazard when driving.

questions.explanation: Black ice is a thin, clear layer of ice. You can see the road through it. It looks like a wet road. Watch for black ice when the road looks wet but the temperature is below freezing.

questions.question: When backing with a trailer, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn the steering wheel toward the direction you want to go.
Turn the steering wheel away from the direction you want to go.
Turn the wheel as sharp as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the steering wheel away from the direction you want to go.
questions.explanation: When backing with a trailer, first turn the steering wheel away from the direction you want the trailer to go. Once the trailer starts to turn, turn the wheel the other way to follow it.

questions.question: What should you know about trains near railroad crossings?

options.text: You will hear every approaching train.
You may not hear a train even if one is coming.
You will hear two short horn blasts if a train is approaching.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not hear a train even if one is coming.
questions.explanation: Never assume you will hear a train. The operator may not blow the horn, or horns may be banned in that area. Noise in your vehicle may also prevent you from hearing a train until it is too close.

questions.question: What happens after two violations of hand-held mobile phone use laws?

options.text: You must cancel your mobile phone service.
Your CDL will be disqualified.
You must drive 10 mph under the speed limit for a period of time.

questions.explanation: If you are convicted twice of violating hand-held mobile phone laws, your CDL will be disqualified. Punishments get stricter with more violations.

questions.question: What should you do shortly after changing a tire?

options.text: Stop and check that the lug nuts are tight.
Repair the brakes.
Let air out of the tire to 10 psi.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and check that the lug nuts are tight.
questions.explanation: After changing a tire, stop after a short time to check that the lug nuts are still tight.

questions.question: If you are being tailgated while driving a large vehicle, which should you NOT do?

options.text: Slow down gradually.
Increase the distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.
Speed up.

questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, increase your following distance and avoid quick movements. Speeding up will only make the other driver tailgate you faster. Do not use your brake lights or flash them at the other driver.

questions.question: When starting from a complete stop, what should happen?

options.text: The vehicle should shift to the right.
The vehicle should be in third gear.
The vehicle should not roll backward.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle should not roll backward.
questions.explanation: Make sure your vehicle does not roll backward when starting from a complete stop. This prevents hitting anything behind you.

questions.question: When there is more alcohol in the body:

options.text: The liver will digest it faster.
The alcohol will have less effect on the person.
It will take longer for the body to remove the alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: It will take longer for the body to remove the alcohol.
questions.explanation: The body removes alcohol at a fixed rate. The more alcohol consumed, the longer it takes the body to remove it.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle, what should you do?

options.text: Apply the air brakes.
Apply the parking brake.
Do not apply brakes if the vehicle is out of gear.

questions.explanation: Always use the parking brake when you park. You can also chock the wheels if needed.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a vehicle inspection report?

options.text: Tell the motor carrier about problems that need fixing.
Make sure the vehicle is inspected regularly.
Hold people responsible for inspecting the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell the motor carrier about problems that need fixing.
questions.explanation: A vehicle inspection report tells the carrier about any problems that need to be fixed.

questions.question: What should you do if an aggressive driver confronts you?

options.text: Make eye contact to communicate with them.
Ignore their gestures.
Stay in their path of travel.

questions.explanation: When confronted by an aggressive driver, get out of their way if you can. Do not make eye contact because it could provoke them. Do not let them upset you with their actions.
